evidence_summary: Official register identifies a pending hybrid application including demolition of redundant agricultural buildings, outline erection of a residential development, and full conversion of an agricultural building to two dwellings. It lists an indicative proposed block plan and proposed floor/elevations. The public HTML register does not expose exact machine-readable Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for each distinct proposed/uncompleted building footprint.
first_missing_criterion: exact machine-readable Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for each distinct proposed/uncompleted building footprint tied to planning reference 2025/2361/FPA
